profileEvidence.summary: Sapsaree preservationist Ha Ji-hong describes these Korean dogs as gentle and strongly loyal. Their modern revival grew from the eight dogs he found in his father’s preservation kennel in 1985. Decades of work at Gyeongsan brought the shaggy native breed back from the brink.
